owner: S04 field-agreement mainline; D6 complete hybrid framework design
goal: PIDL-derived method approaches FEM fields; user-authorized route redesign to constrained incremental variation plus FEM-neural hybrid.

material.status: Frozen new design document under untracked design directory; reviewed byte identity, not a clean implemented code snapshot.

scope: Full design text and targeted existing source/protocol semantics only. No new scientific computation, arrays, model load, FEM solve, training, GPU/SSH, literature refresh or source change.

checks.finding: New nodal lower/box/hard-line K is explicit and stronger than existing GP-QP/soft FEM. Matched direct constrained FEM is the causal quality/cost comparator; historical FEM/PIDL remain descriptive. No promise of identical nonconvex branch.
Fixed-f variational blocks plus accepted-state trial map/fixed point are distinguished from joint differentiation through fatigue. No unsupported full-loop monotonicity or global-optimality claim.

Final mechanics, fresh damage operator/KKT, f consistency and feasibility are checked at the same final u/d/q and old lower. Prior local QP certificate is explicitly invalidated after mechanics/q changes.

NN only supplies one feasible coupled initial guess per physical substep. Numerical damage correction uses full K, all active constraints can release, and no predicted process-zone restriction survives.

Trial A is rebuilt from immutable accepted A/r, lower never rolls inside solve, r stores current accepted driver, commit is atomic once, restart uses accepted version. Eta0 nullspace is either physically equivalent gauge handling or a reported stop; no silent residual stiffness or pseudoinverse.

Only same-new-problem jointly accepted labels qualify; online own-state rollout, whole-trajectory/parameter grouping, no future FEM input or online reference selection. Label availability is explicitly unknown; no placeholder hybrid result.

Matched NN-off and classical extrapolation separate numerical-solver repair from learned benefit. All preparation/correction/fallback work is charged. Break-even and Amdahl calculations are algebraically correct, explicitly illustrative. No speed or accuracy advantage over same-problem direct FEM asserted. Full paths, f<1 and critical regimes address route-scale value.

source_locations.checked_for: Fixed-u/f convex AT1 assembly and existing nodal-box plus GP-lower domain.
Full mechanical solve, near-singular rejection and final residual reassembly.
Trial history rebuilt from immutable accepted state; old certificate reuse risk after final mechanics/q.
Native Q4 energy coefficient normalization and GP finite penalty.
PIDL accepted-history update semantics and detached Carrara increment.
Historical fixed-f soft-penalty log loss and parameter regularization.
GP trial active driver, accepted A/driver base, fatigue coefficient without df/dd, recovery/irreversibility soft penalties.

limits: This is conceptual/algorithmic design approval, not Code Ready or producer-ready.
No model, label supply, numerical convergence, field improvement, acceleration, generalization or physical-teacher validity is established.
The design changes the variational feasible domain; old-FEM fidelity and same-problem hybrid cost are separate comparisons.

The historical c1_commit_protocol/v4 citation was not independently located in this worktree during this review; transaction assessment relies on the complete explicit v1 contract and inspected trial-map/source semantics, not an unseen receipt.

required_before_execution.required: Bind admissible accepted state0, mesh/GP order, material scaling Gc/ell=w1, actual five-substep load path, full trajectory/task split, reference role and frozen primary/cost criterion. New node-K must never be relabelled as unchanged historical FEM.

Implement node lower and hard-line elimination, complete feasible-direction correction and active release; fresh final damage and mechanics audit with testable cache fingerprints. Fix numerical normalization/tolerances, block/globalization/linear-solver settings and joint iteration/time caps prospectively.

Test repeated trial idempotence from preimage, no inner fatigue accumulation, stale-certificate rejection, failure/write/crash rollback, single durable version commit/restart and eta0 compatible/near-singular failure policy. Residual checks must use original operators after any numerical damping.

Determine availability and full generation/storage cost of eligible new-K consecutive labels before training; freeze GP feature projection, graph coverage/coarse mapping, normalizations, clipping derivative/initialization and supervised loss scaling. Freeze model before evaluation; characterize own-state covariate shift and fallback.

Use identical physical backends/hardware/thread/precision/acceptance tolerances; avoid double-charging or omitting common predictor/re-equilibration via explicit work IDs. Count feature/transfer, setup, all correction/failure/fallback, labels/training, memory and cold/amortized costs. A learned initial guess is useful only if measured end-to-end savings survive these costs.

No runner/model/result is delivered here. Future implementation requires relevant deterministic verification and exact snapshot independent Code Ready review plus an authorized resource/data card; this design receipt does not authorize training, FEM or opening held-out arrays.

conclusion: The coherent framework removes the stated neural-tangent, soft-domain and stale-final-state acceptance risks at the design level and defines a falsifiable learned-initialization value against strong matched direct FEM/classical predictors. Approve v1 as a design for implementation preparation; no design revision is required before that preparation. Preserve the no-compute authorization boundary.
